headline: Last session: Sensex fell 570 points as markets close today for Gandhi Jayanti holiday

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Monday, 5 October.

why: Foreign institutional investors engaged in en-masse selling of Indian equities, wiping out Rs 9 lakh crore in market value.
Rising crude oil prices and global rate hikes sparked continuous capital outflows.
US Treasury yields rose to 5.34%, reaching their highest level since 2002 and putting pressure on emerging markets.
Indian benchmark shares posted their longest weekly losing run in 25 years and recorded their worst month since March.
whatHappening: BSE and NSE remain closed today, October 2, 2026, on account of Gandhi Jayanti.
In the last session, Sensex dropped 570.59 points while Nifty fell to 22,421.95.
Commodity markets including MCX are also closed today for the holiday.
Trading in Indian equity benchmark indices will resume on Monday, October 5.
summary: Indian stock markets are closed today, October 2, 2026, for Gandhi Jayanti. In the previous trading session, benchmark indices registered sharp declines as Sensex dropped over 570 points amid heavy foreign investor selling. Markets will reopen for regular trading on Monday, October 5.
